datasets.title: Japan: High Resolution Population Density Maps + Demographic Estimates
datasets.description: The world's most accurate population datasets. Seven maps/datasets for the distribution of various populations in Japan: (1) Overall population density (2) Women (3) Men (4) Children (ages 0-5) (5) Youth (ages 15-24) (6) Elderly (ages 60+) (7) Women of reproductive age (ages 15-49).. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/japan-high-resolution-population-density-maps-demographic-estimates]
datasets.details: To reference this data, please use the following citation: Facebook Connectivity Lab and Center for International Earth Science Information Network - CIESIN - Columbia University. 2016. High Resolution Settlement Layer (HRSL). Source imagery for HRSL © 2016 DigitalGlobe. Accessed DAY MONTH YEAR.' Please note that as of 2024, Meta's high resolution population density maps are no longer being updated.

creator.name: AI and Data for Good at Meta

lineage.description: High-resolution population density maps were created by identifying building footprints from commercial satellite imagery using machine learning, then overlaying population estimates derived from publicly available census data and demographic statistics in partnership with Columbia University. The resulting gridded datasets represent population distribution at fine spatial resolution for Japan in 2019-2020, disaggregated by demographic cohorts.

sources.name: Facebook Data for Good
sources.description: Machine learning-derived building footprints from satellite imagery used as the spatial framework for population distribution mapping

sources.name: Columbia University
sources.description: Population estimation methodology and census data integration for disaggregating population counts to high-resolution grid cells
